text: Mag Mór was an Irish mythological site. Its name means the great plain. It was also written Mag Mor or Magh Mhór. The plain lay in the Otherworld. There the dead lived, walking without rest across its flat surface. People saw it as a parallel dimension. It stayed reachable from this world. Folklore suggests the belief survived in Ireland until about 70 years ago.
